method: Compare English pages built from the public edition stores with their dated rankings and ordered paper URLs. Independently group native records, normalized DOIs, PubMed IDs and linked preprint versions for the November 17–20 ranked papers. For every shared work, verify the dated links and the displayed sources in both directions. Count a pair once per date and count each reading direction separately in the link totals. Check the three latest edition pages as well as the dated pages. In Chromium, open a shared paper ranking below rank 20 and return by keyboard and link at both tested widths. Search Physics for “assembly bias” and open the ranked topic.
